notes.title: Last level progress before the early access
notes.content: [p]So we are getting very close to the early access that will be avaible from the begining of November [/p][p]this year![/p][p][/p][p]Workig on the catacombs level and by that the last level of the early access will be completed!![/p][p][/p][p]Super excited to deliever you that game=)))[/p][p][/p][p]Heres a lil screen shot from it...[/p][p][/p][p]A big gameplay trailer is on the way too so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/a8711db8dc33b7ae9e8ac492d354e2cc9adc6690.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: More Issues fixed now!
notes.content: [p][b]If you dont like a sound in the demo it is not a bug its a matter of taste![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]And yes I have fixed some more stuff...[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]have fun![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: HeadBob,Weapons Sway and more!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Well the demo was updated for the last time and final![/p][p]It is almost as the full release and no more updates will be implemented![/p][p][/p][p]Early Access will be avaible in mid Novmber this year=)[/p][p][/p][p]anyway take a look and have fun there![/p][p][/p][p]BTW now when you aim at enemies the crosshair becomes red so you know you are locked on=)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/6ff013adc02056ec5c8cb5f3b73c96c5d63edd4f.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Castle of the Hideous
notes.content: [p]Well,Good news are Im currently working on that castle and it got a boss in it![/p][p][/p][p]Second thing is that there are now pick ups for every weapon![/p][p][/p][p]and the Electric Staff is now avaible in that Castle and beyond=)[/p][p][/p][p]Other cool stuff are a cool head bob and a good weapon sway when moving...[/p][p]And now you have and armor that takes some good amount of damage to itself and keeps you more safe then ever.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are some screen shots from todays work:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/b0175ad20b6767bf3ac248f8ddadbc4a05a97274.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/6ff013adc02056ec5c8cb5f3b73c96c5d63edd4f.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New enemies added a Huge Spider and Elf Female Mage
notes.content: [p]Hey guys![/p][p]long time no update...[/p][p]So i have added 2 new levels with new enemies which you can see in the screen shots section.[/p][p][/p][p]Or here:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/f08bb93697339d0ef924575b1c02740060d2b3c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/61aa14e773d7b1ed0f5a973edd4253c0ecd1d961.jpg"][/img][/p][p]anyway the game is in the beta stage almost and will be ready in the next 3 ro 3.5 months:)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hideous Demo latest updates!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/89f92257d2cd4632599d629d6ed708da28355baa.png"][/img]So basically the demo is ready to be fully exposed.[/p][p]I have added a new dialog at the first crypt with a dying warrior.[/p][p]Now when you shoot at objects the projectiles will collide with the walls and the floor.[/p][p]A weapon switvch animations were added to the weapons and it is now much more fun to switch them![/p][p][/p][p]Mainly some other bugs were fixed like now you are now not slowing down in mid air when you jump+a jump sfx was added so its making this fun retro jump sound like in quake or other retro shooters![/p][p][/p][p]Have fun now![/p][p][/p][p]And spread the game=))[/p]

notes.title: The Demo is up again!
notes.content: [p]We made alot of changes in the Save and Load system.[/p][p]Added diologs+Options and minor bugs with enemies were fixed...[/p][p]Weapon switch animations are now part of the game too![/p][p][/p][p]The demo is avaible again and is much better that what it was![/p][p]I hope you will have fun now with the game=)[/p][p][/p][p]If you are still encounter some issues here and then please report we want the game to be the best it can...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/e727d59effdd17b11f8e9d57f8c752928c07c913.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Options section is finally ready!
notes.content: [p]We updated the options window and now it got all it needs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/e727d59effdd17b11f8e9d57f8c752928c07c913.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Options added
notes.content: [p]Well,we added options since in the demo version we didn't had the time to.[/p][p]It's simple but basically it is all that was needed. [/p][p]In such a game there is no really a reason to add rtx or vsync.[/p][p]Maybe we will add mouse sensitivity but for now it is what it is:)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/e8cd9024861380cc8b31e96b01f7ac1b83965f20.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Hideous Castle
notes.content: [p]Hey guys![/p][p]Thanks for wishlisting and playing the demo![/p][p]Yes it is buggy now but don't worry most is now fixed and we creating the next level![/p][p]As you can see:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/4d5c3da968697be66063fbcd5b2afc770efaf7e2.jpg"][/img]Thanka again and good night;)[/p]

notes.content: [p]Hey Everyone![/p][p]Just finished to work on the first boss and the third level out of 9![/p][p]This is going to be a challenge to kick his butt;)[/p][p]But you can do it we know that=)[/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice day and stay tuned for more.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610003/754dc5723cb46400fecd6b74f6571dd08fd46b32.jpg"][/img][/p]
